title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
title_zh: NexSight：面向细粒度智能体长视频理解的可验证任务
abstract_en: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks fail to refute it. This yields SightLine, 310 evidence-traceable tasks from 108 long videos, evaluated through SightLoop, a shared multiscale harness supporting temporal exploration, local inspection, evidence integration, and revisiting while recording returned observations. On disjoint videos, solver trajectories on verified tasks become step-level supervision for observation decisions. The strongest model reaches only 54.52% on SightLine, yet 79.35% when given the annotated evidence. With under 6K examples, Sight-35B nearly doubles its base model's interactive accuracy (21.29% to 42.26%), outperforms the 397B model of its family, begins using explicit spatial inspection after post-training, which its base model never uses, and gains over 8 points on two external long-video benchmarks.
abstract_zh: 细粒度长视频问答要求模型判断动作出现的总次数、事件发生的先后顺序，或状态变化的准确时刻。相关证据可能只是散落在数小时视频中的短暂片段：找到一次动作只能证明它发生过，要确认总次数，还必须检查是否有遗漏或重复计数。仅用最终答案训练，也无法直接监督模型如何寻找证据。NexSight 为评估和训练智能体的长视频理解能力构建了可验证任务。其流程 SightForge 仅在满足两项条件时接受任务：未看到候选答案的验证器能根据从原始视频中重新密集采集的证据重建答案，且反例检查未能推翻该答案。由此构建的 SightLine 包含来自 108 段长视频的 310 项证据可追溯任务，并通过统一的多尺度框架 SightLoop 进行评估。SightLoop 支持时间轴探索、局部检查、证据整合和回看，同时记录每次操作返回的观测结果。研究还利用与评测集不重叠的视频上的解题轨迹，为模型的观测决策提供逐步监督。最强模型在 SightLine 上的准确率仅为 54.52%，直接提供标注证据后升至 79.35%。使用不足 6,000 个训练样例，Sight-35B 将基座模型的交互式准确率从 21.29% 提升至 42.26%，超越同系列的 397B 模型；它还学会了基座模型从未使用的显式空间检查，并在两个外部长视频基准上各提升超过 8 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 证明动作发生过不等于验证其总次数。SightForge 通过独立重建答案和反例检查，降低漏计与重复计数的风险。
SightLine 收录 108 段长视频中的 310 项证据可追溯任务；SightLoop 统一多尺度交互接口，并记录模型实际获得的观测结果。
最强模型的准确率从自行搜索时的 54.52% 升至直接获得标注证据时的 79.35%，表明寻找证据是重要瓶颈。
不足 6,000 个训练样例使 Sight-35B 的交互式准确率从 21.29% 升至 42.26%，超过同系列 397B 模型，并在两个外部基准上各提升超过 8 个百分点。

agent-multimodal.reason: 核心贡献是让智能体在固定预算下主动选取长视频片段、局部检查并回看证据的 SightLoop，并利用求解轨迹对观察决策做逐步监督。同预算对照显示，主动选窗显著提高证据召回率，但相对固定选窗的答题准确率增益不显著；联合后训练提高了交互准确率，但未分离问答监督与轨迹监督的各自作用。
